content: Yi hakana ni, baphangi bama batondama, benu babana yisi yukila tsambu ya lawu mu kulumona, benu lwenina kyesi kyama yi mukhonzi wama, kalenu bakwikama muna luzingu lwenu yi Pfumu.
Milongi
Yibahekini kikesa Evwodi yi Setiki ni bayukanaka bawu yi bawu mwena Pfumu.

Kwena ngeyi phi mukwetu wa kyedika wa kisalu, yikulombini ni wabasadisa, mukuma banwaniki lawu kikuma kya Musamu wa Bukheti, mu kithwadi yi meni; phila mosi phi yi Kelemasi yi bakwetu bahika ba kisalu, babana básonama mazina ma bawu muna mukanda wa moya.
Sangwalakenu kosu tangwa mu kithwadi yi Pfumu; ndanduludibwa hika ni sangwalakenu.
Yambulenu buweti bwenu bwazayakana kwena batu boosu. Pfumu wekina bela-bela.
Ludiyangisaku kikuma kya kima kimosi, kaasi muna mambu moosu, hanakenu bilomba byenu kwena Nzambi muna nzila ya kubokwadila hakimosi yi makabu ma kuvutula kwa matondu.
Amana ngemba ya Nzambi yina yihitini mabanza moosu yalúnda mbundu zenu yi mabanza menu mwena Kidisitu Yesu.

Mu kumanisa baphangi bama, mambu moosu mana menina ma kyedika, moosu mana menina ma kitoku, moosu mana menina ma masonga, moosu mana menina ma kasemi, moosu mana misi sephidisa batu, yuka ni ndyambu dimosi dya bukheti dyenina hana, yindulakenu kikuma kya mawu.
Mambu moosu mana lwálonguka, lwátambula yi mana lwáyuka kwena meni kondilo mana lwámona kwena meni, sadilenu mamana. Amana Nzambi wa ngemba kakála yi benu.
Pholu vutudini matondu kwena bisi Fidiphu
Tsangwadi lawu mwena Pfumu, kikuma tsuka-tsuka, lungyubuki hika. Bwa kyedika ni lumbanziki kedi, kaasi lukadikiku yi phila ya kusongilabwa.
Nzonzidibwoku ni kikuma kya kukonda kima, kikuma yílonguka kedi mu kukalaka mu kyesi muna mutindu wuna yenina.

Nzayini mu kuzingila mu kiphutu bwosu buna pfwani phi yizingila mu bima bya lawu. Yílonguka mu kukala sangu-sangu kosu tangwa yi muma mwosu, keti ngyukutini, ho loni yenina yi nzala, keti yenina yi bima byafwana, ho loni khondi kima.
Pfwani yisala mambu moosu muna nzila ya yandi wuna wisi pheka ngolu.
Kaasi bwa buketi luhangini mu kungwaphama mu mambu matadidini biwayi byama.

Luzayibwa kwenu bukheti, benu-benu bisi Fidiphu: tangwa yíkatuka ku Masetwani, muna tangwa dina yíyandika kuyadingisa kwa Musamu wa Bukheti, benu lwákala Dibundu dimosi mu kutsadisa, benu lwesi lwákota mambu matadidini phasi zama keti mu kyesi kyama.
Mukuma, ha yíkala ku Tesalonika, benu phi lwáphitika hika mu mbala ya zodi bina yíkala byawu mupfunu.
Heku ni makabu mbati sanda; kima mbati sanda, lufutu lwa mihangu myenu mya bukheti lwayikama hika kikuma kya benu.

Yenina yi bima byosu amana yenina byawu hika lawu, mbongibya byosu bina luphitikiki muna moku ma Ephafoditi. Mana menina mananasi ma mvumba ya kitoku, kimenga kina katambwasini Nzambi, kina kyisi musephidisa yandi.
Nzambi wama kabásisa byosu bina luvwini mupfunu, bwosu buna kyenina kimvwama kyandi, muna khembu, mwena Kidisitu Yesu.
Khembu yakala kwena Nzambi yi Tata wetu, mvula yi mvula! Abwabuna
Mboti za tsuka
Hanenu mboti kwena bakwikidi boosu mwena Kidisitu Yesu. Baphangi babana benina ha kimosi yi meni, mboti baluhekini.
Bakwikidi boosu, mboti baluhekini; theti-theti basadi bana benina mu nganda ya Khayisala.
Yambula khenda za Pfumu Yesu Kidisitu zakala muna kitembu kyenu!
